rows.whatYouDo_da: Pizzaer bages i ovn; kødsaucer og pasta koges gennemvarmet.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Pizzas are oven-baked; meat sauces and pasta are cooked through.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Utilstrækkelig opvarmning dræber ikke bakterier i kød og fjerkræ.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Insufficient heating fails to kill bacteria in meat and poultry.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Core temperature of at least 75 °C checked for risk dishes.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Retten varmes videre til centrumtemperaturen er nået.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Continue heating until core temperature is reached.

hazards.controlMeasure_en: Core temperature measured with a probe.
hazards.justification_da: Kødsaucer laves i store portioner, hvor centrum opvarmes langsomt.
hazards.justification_en: Meat sauces are made in large batches where the core heats slowly.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Salater og kold pynt tilberedes på separat bord med rene redskaber.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Salads and cold garnishes prepared on a separate bench with clean utensils.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Krydskontaminering fra råt kød til spiseklar mad.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Cross-contamination from raw meat to ready-to-eat food.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Adskilte skærebrætter og redskaber; håndhygiejne mellem opgaver.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Separate boards and utensils; hand hygiene between tasks.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Berørt mad kasseres; bord og redskaber rengøres.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Discard affected food; clean bench and utensils.

hazards.description_da: Overførsel af bakterier fra råvarer til spiseklar mad.
hazards.description_en: Transfer of bacteria from raw ingredients to ready-to-eat food.
hazards.controlMeasure_da: Adskillelse i tid og sted; separate redskaber.
hazards.controlMeasure_en: Separation in time and place; separate utensils.
hazards.justification_da: Salater varmebehandles ikke, så kontaminering fjernes ikke senere.
hazards.justification_en: Salads get no heat step, so contamination is never removed.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Kødsauce og suppe varmholdes i gryde/bain-marie under service.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Meat sauce and soup are hot-held in a pot/bain-marie during service.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Temperatur under 56 °C tillader bakterievækst i timerne under service.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Temperature below 56 °C allows growth during service hours.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Varmholdelse ved mindst 56 °C; temperatur kontrolleres under service.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Hot-holding at 56 °C minimum; temperature checked during service.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Under grænsen: genopvarm til over 75 °C eller kassér.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Below the limit: reheat above 75 °C or discard.

hazards.description_da: Vækst af sporedannende bakterier (Bacillus, Clostridium) ved lav varmholdelsestemperatur.
hazards.description_en: Growth of spore-formers (Bacillus, Clostridium) at low hot-holding temperature.
hazards.justification_en: Sauces are hot-held across the whole evening.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Ragù og saucer laves i store portioner og nedkøles til næste dag.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Ragù and sauces are made in large batches and cooled for the next day.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Langsom nedkøling giver sporedannende bakterier mulighed for vækst.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Slow cooling lets spore-forming bacteria grow.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Nedkøling fra 56 °C til 10 °C på højst 4 timer; portioner deles i lave beholdere.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Cooling from 56 °C to 10 °C within 4 hours; batches split into shallow containers.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: For langsom nedkøling: genopvarm straks eller kassér.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Too slow: reheat immediately or discard.

hazards.description_da: Vækst af Clostridium perfringens ved langsom nedkøling af store portioner.
hazards.description_en: Growth of Clostridium perfringens during slow cooling of large batches.
hazards.controlMeasure_da: Nedkølingstid og temperatur registreres pr. portion.
hazards.controlMeasure_en: Cooling time and temperature logged per batch.
hazards.justification_en: Large pots of ragù are cooled daily.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Råt kød håndteres adskilt fra spiseklar mad i tid og med separate redskaber.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Raw meat handled separately from ready-to-eat food in time and with separate utensils.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Krydskontaminering via hænder, brætter og knive.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Cross-contamination via hands, boards and knives.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_da: Berørt mad kasseres; flader rengøres og desinficeres.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Discard affected food; clean and disinfect surfaces.

hazards.description_en: Bacterial transfer from raw to ready-to-eat.
hazards.justification_da: Åbent køkken med begrænset plads øger risikoen.
hazards.justification_en: An open kitchen with limited space raises the risk.

rows.whatYouDo_da: Mel (gluten) bruges overalt; nødder kun i enkelte desserter.
rows.whatYouDo_en: Flour (gluten) is used everywhere; nuts only in a few desserts.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_da: Allergen krydskontakt til retter bestilt uden allergenet.
rows.whatCanGoWrong_en: Allergen cross-contact into dishes ordered without the allergen.
rows.controlMeasures_da: Desserter med nødder tilberedes adskilt; personalet kender allergenlisten.
rows.controlMeasures_en: Nut desserts prepared separately; staff know the allergen list.
rows.ifItGoesWrong_en: Remake the dish; inform the guest.

hazards.description_en: Cross-contact with gluten/nuts for allergic guests.
hazards.controlMeasure_en: Separate preparation and an up-to-date allergen list.
hazards.justification_da: Melstøv i luften gør glutenfri tilberedning svær — gæster informeres ærligt.
hazards.justification_en: Airborne flour makes gluten-free preparation hard — guests are informed honestly.

tighterLimits.reason_da: Varmholdelse ved 50 °C er lettere at holde i praksis.
